ui.goal_title: Journey’s end: a rest beneath the walnut tree.
ui.goal_text_html: At the end of the route you will find shade beneath the walnut tree, regional wines and spritzers, a toilet, free e-bike charging and, on hot days, an air-conditioned room. From March to October, daily from 9 am to 10 pm.
ui.overview_title: Map: five cycle routes to the Genussplatzl, from Spielfeld via Mureck, from Bad Gleichenberg, from St. Anna am Aigen via Klöch, from Bad Radkersburg and from Apače across the Steirerbrücke
ui.ebike_title: E-bike charging on the Mur Cycle Path and R45 in Halbenrain | s’Genussplatz’l
ui.ebike_desc: Free e-bike charging point on the Gleichenberg cycle route R45 in Unterpurkla, Halbenrain, just before the Mur Cycle Path R2. Charge in the shade beneath the walnut tree, March to October.
ui.ebike_h1: E-bike charging by the cycle path.
ui.ebike_lead: Charge your battery free of charge while you rest beneath the walnut tree: right on the Gleichenberg cycle route R45, just before the Mur Cycle Path.
ui.ebike_when_value: March to October, 9 am to 10 pm
ui.ebike_alt: Bicycle next to the charging point at the Genussplatzl
ui.ebike_how_text: Park your bike at the charging point, plug in your charger and treat yourself to a break. While the battery charges, you can enjoy shade beneath the walnut tree, regional wines and spritzers, cool drinks, a toilet and, on hot days, an air-conditioned room.

ui.index_desc: A rest beneath the walnut tree in Unterpurkla: an oasis of calm in the Tuscany of Styria, with regional wines, art and natural shade on the Gleichenberg cycle route R45.
ui.ld_desc: Rest stop beneath the walnut tree on the Gleichenberg cycle route R45 in Unterpurkla: regional wines, art and natural shade in the Thermen- & Vulkanland, the Tuscany of Styria.

west.name: Mur Cycle Path from Spielfeld
west.lead: The classic route on the Mur: flat along the river, via Mureck, all the way to us in Unterpurkla.
west.ways: Mur Cycle Path R2, finally the Gleichenberg cycle route R45
west.title: Mur Cycle Path from Spielfeld to Unterpurkla, cycle route with GPX
west.desc: Cycle route on the Mur Cycle Path R2 from Spielfeld via Mureck to s’Genussplatz’l in Unterpurkla: approx. 27 km, flat, with map, elevation profile and GPX download.
west.index_text: The classic route on the Mur, from the west via Mureck and its ship mill, set back on the water in 1997 after a historic model.
stops: Spielfeld
Border town on the Mur, right by the South Styrian Wine Road. This is where the ride downstream begins.
Mureck
The ship mill was set back on the Mur in 1997 after a historic model, one of the last floating ship mills in Central Europe.
Gosdorf
Through the Mur’s riverside meadows, surrounded by the UNESCO Mura-Drava-Danube Biosphere Reserve.
s’Genussplatz’l
A rest beneath the walnut tree with regional wines, shade, a toilet, a free e-bike charging point and an air-conditioned room for hot days.

nord.name: R45 from Bad Gleichenberg
nord.h1: From Bad Gleichenberg through the Vulkanland.
nord.lead: Along the Gleichenberg cycle route R45 from the spa town gently downhill to the Mur, through the villages, fields and hills of the Vulkanland.
nord.title: R45 from Bad Gleichenberg to Unterpurkla, cycle route with GPX
nord.desc: Gleichenberg cycle route R45 from Bad Gleichenberg via Trautmannsdorf and Radochen to s’Genussplatz’l in Unterpurkla: approx. 20 km, gently downhill, with GPX.
nord.index_text: From the north, from the spa town in the heart of the Vulkanland; the Gleichenberg cycle route runs right past our door.
stops: Bad Gleichenberg
Spa town in the heart of the Vulkanland and a stage town of the Bike & Spa loop, whose stage from Mureck runs past us on the R45.
Trautmannsdorf
The R45 leaves the spa town heading south, through the gently rolling hills.
Radochen
The last few kilometres through fields and villages, until the Mur comes into view.
s’Genussplatz’l
A rest beneath the walnut tree with regional wines, shade, a toilet, a free e-bike charging point and an air-conditioned room for hot days.

nordost.name: From St. Anna am Aigen via Klöch
nordost.h1: From St. Anna through the vineyards.
nordost.lead: The hilly route through wine country: from St. Anna am Aigen via Klöch, home of the Traminer, down to us by the Mur.
nordost.ways: Cycle paths and back roads through the Klöch wine country
nordost.title: Cycle tour St. Anna am Aigen, Klöch, Unterpurkla with GPX
nordost.desc: Cycle tour from St. Anna am Aigen via Klöch to s’Genussplatz’l in Unterpurkla: approx. 19 km, hilly, around 150 m of climbing, with map and GPX download.
nordost.index_text: From the north-east through the vineyards of the Vulkanland, via Klöch, wine country on record since 1444 and home of the Traminer. Gently hilly, around 150 m of climbing.
stops: St. Anna am Aigen
Wine village in the Vulkanland. From here the route heads south through the vineyards.
Klöch
Wine country on record since 1444. Volcanic soils give the Traminer its scent of roses; there is also a vinotheque, a wine-growing museum and a castle ruin.
s’Genussplatz’l
A rest beneath the walnut tree with regional wines, shade, a toilet, a free e-bike charging point and an air-conditioned room for hot days.

ost.name: From Bad Radkersburg
ost.h1: From Bad Radkersburg up the Mur.
ost.lead: Short and flat: from the old town on the Mur via Dietzen to us in Unterpurkla, ideal as an outing from the thermal spa.
ost.ways: Mur Cycle Path R2, finally the Gleichenberg cycle route R45
ost.title: Cycle route Bad Radkersburg to Unterpurkla with GPX
ost.desc: Cycle route from Bad Radkersburg on the Mur to s’Genussplatz’l in Unterpurkla: approx. 12 km, flat, with map, elevation profile and GPX download.
ost.index_text: From the east, from the old town and Parktherme spa on the Mur, the starting point of the Thermal Spa Cycle Path R12.
stops: Bad Radkersburg
Old town and Parktherme spa on the Mur, starting point of the Thermal Spa Cycle Path R12 and a stage town of the Bike & Spa loop.
Dietzen
Flat through the fields on the edge of the Mur’s riverside meadows.
s’Genussplatz’l
A rest beneath the walnut tree with regional wines, shade, a toilet, a free e-bike charging point and an air-conditioned room for hot days.

sued.name: From Apače in Slovenia
sued.lead: The shortest route comes from Slovenia: across the suspension bridge and through the Mur’s riverside meadows, and you are with us in half an hour.
sued.ways: Cycle paths on both banks of the Mur, Steirerbrücke, finally the Gleichenberg cycle route R45
sued.title: Cycle route Apače, Steirerbrücke, Unterpurkla with GPX
sued.desc: Cycle route from Apače in Slovenia across the Steirerbrücke to s’Genussplatz’l in Unterpurkla: approx. 7 km, flat, with map and GPX download.
sued.index_text: From the south across the Steirerbrücke, a suspension footbridge that has spanned 82.5 metres over the Mur since 2006, right through the riverside meadows of the Mura-Drava-Danube Biosphere Reserve.
stops: Apače
Village on the Slovenian bank of the Mur, the starting point for the bridge to Austria.
Steirerbrücke
Since 2006 this suspension bridge has swung 82.5 metres across the Mur, right in the heart of the UNESCO Mura-Drava-Danube Biosphere Reserve.
s’Genussplatz’l
A rest beneath the walnut tree with regional wines, shade, a toilet, a free e-bike charging point and an air-conditioned room for hot days.

spielfeld: Start at the border: a new footbridge crosses the Mur here to Ceršak.
mureck: The small town on the Mur, seen from the Slovenian bank.
mureck-muehle: Back on the Mur since 1997, one of Central Europe's last floating mills.
murauen: Gravel banks and riverside forest in the UNESCO biosphere reserve, seen from the Murturm in Gosdorf.
gleichenberg-kurpark: Old trees and wide lawns at the start of the route.
gleichenberg: Wooded domes of extinct volcanoes around the spa town.
trautmannsdorf: Village and parish church on the hillside just south of Bad Gleichenberg.
st-anna: St. Anna am Aigen parish church
The church on the hilltop above the vineyards, at the start of the route.
kloech-wein: Wine growing since 1444, home of Traminer with its scent of roses.
kloech-ruine: The tower of the old castle behind the rows of vines.
radkersburg-platz: Town hall tower, Marian column and old town houses.
radkersburg-mur: The old town in a bend of the Mur, right on the border.
halbenrain-schloss: The castle in the next village, just a few minutes from us.
apace: The village on the Slovenian bank, with its Church of the Assumption.
bruecke: Since 2006 the suspension bridge has spanned 82.5 metres across the Mur.
